C270.notes: SER AS-JP-004. Value-side photo confirmed (portrait white 2×2 · EXIF-oriented) · user cue 昭和六十三年 / 1988 · big 10 inside a bay laurel wreath (Japan Mint: evergreen / tokiwa leaves; Wikipedia & Smithsonian: bay laurel — not tachibana, which rides the ¥500). Date kanji clearly 昭和六十三年 = Shōwa 63 = 1988. Byōdō-in Phoenix Hall / 日本国 / 十円 side not shown. Same Y#73a smooth-edge bronze type as C220 / AS-JP-003 (1982 Shōwa 57 10¥) — keep both; different year, not a duplicate. Aluminum 1¥ ladder siblings C222 / AS-JP-001 (1965) · C206 / AS-JP-002 (1976). Story hook: Shōwa 63 was the last full calendar year of the Shōwa era — Emperor Hirohito died 1989-01-07, so Shōwa 64 lasted only one week (1–7 Jan) before Heisei began 1989-01-08. Vending / train / konbini bronze weight in the final full year of a 62-year reign. Japan flips now 4.
